original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: List the existing independent checks for the exact selected or candidate sources. Pick a new changed input, missing binding or distinct failure mode; stop with a handoff if the proposed arithmetic check is already covered.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Audit the scale-dependent seed-switching mechanism in Discussion2278: exact counterexample to unqualified scalar-root averaging and direct finite-catalogue extremal comparison.
scope_change_reason: Explicit Discussion1167 mechanism scope and live single-letter lane supplied a concrete new recursive-cost implication; no selected root or unrelated audit is repeated.
bottleneck_link: Seed switching changes the recursive cost recurrence. The counterexample prevents assigning a favorable averaged saving without retaining reached scale phases; the comparison theorem preserves a scoped best-fixed-seed conclusion.
stop_rule: One decisive counterexample or corroboration and repaired statement; no seed synthesis or further round.
evidence: PROOF.md written all-scale counterexample/comparison; verify.py exact full-rank recurrence; independent.py and REVIEW.md separate derivation and exhaustive rank-history checks.
author: Ross Richardson
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1 Sol Max assistance in derivation, source review, implementation, execution and writing; one separate mathematical worker; no independent human or formal-kernel proof.

open_questions.question: For a proposed growing-seed family, do the complete scale-indexed moments and glue/adapters satisfy an o(log x) exponent-error bound?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without that bound a log-scale root average can overstate the recursive saving.
open_questions.first_step: Specify one actual family and caller, preserve every child rank and reached scale phase, then bound the cumulative oscillation and all glue/adapter costs.
open_questions.blocked_by: No physical family or paid consumer is constructed by this audit.

overlap_coverage.limitations: Remote PR scope includes open and closed/merged titles and bodies, with separate coverage and timestamps. State changes are deduplicated by latest PR update; snapshots are not atomic. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
